options: fig. I is better because the weld is in shear and the principal stress in the weld is not in line with P
fig. I is better because the load transfer from the tie bar to the plate is not direct
fig. II is better because the weld is in tension and safe stress of weld in tension is greater than that in shear
fig. II is better because it has less stress concentration
